name: smwsprites-koopas-shells-disco-shell
title: Koopas + Shells + Disco Shell
description:
This is a disassembly (+ some added features) of sprites 4-7, the normal Koopas, and DA-DF, the Shells (normal and Disco variant). It includes a lot of options that can be set either with the extra bytes or with the defines (check out the asm files for more info).
It's included a json file for each Koopa color that will set up a list of sprites in LM's menu with all the main variants (Koopa, stationary Shell with or without a Koopa inside, kicked Shell, Disco Shell).
